title: Actual normalization stalks are integral-closure localizations of generic tensor factors
statement: Let $B$ be a DVR domain [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] with irreducible uniformizer $\pi$, fraction field $K$, and $n>0$. Let $E_i/K$, indexed by $i\in\operatorname{Fin}(r)$, be finite Galois field extensions [def-weil-field, def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. Suppose $p:X\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ is identified over $K$ with the coproduct of $\operatorname{Spec}E_i$. Put $A=B[t]/(t^n-\pi)$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] and let $a:X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}B}\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be the base change of $p$ followed by $\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}B$. Assume $a$ is qcqs. For every point $x$ of its concrete relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization] whose image prime is $(t)$, there are an index $i$, a maximal ideal $P$ in $D_i=E_i\otimes_B A$, and a prime $Q$ of $S=\operatorname{integralClosure}_A(D_i/P)$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure], contracting to $(t)$ in $A$, together with a ring isomorphism $S_Q\simeq\mathcal O_{a.\mathrm{normalization},x}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. For every $s\in A$, this isomorphism maps its structural image in $S_Q$ to the actual structural stalk germ at $x$. All $B$-algebra structures on $E_i$ are the composites through $K$, and the $A$-algebra structure on $D_i/P$ is the right tensor inclusion. No invertibility or degree divisibility hypothesis on $n$ is assumed.

proof.text: The monic polynomial X^n-C(pi) makes A module finite over B. Base change therefore makes every E_i tensor_B A module finite over the field E_i, hence Artinian. Apply dvr_galois_root_tensor_reduced to get reducedness of each tensor algebra. Compose the coproduct equation over K with Spec K -> Spec B to obtain the same presentation over B.

Apply reduced_artinian_tensor_normalization_charts with these Artinian and reduced tensor algebras. Obtain a maximal factor P and an open immersion c from Spec S containing x and commuting with the structural map to Spec A. Write x=c(y) and take Q=y.asIdeal.

Evaluate the equation c followed by fromNormalization = Spec(A -> S) at y. The ideal of the right side is Q.comap(algebraMap A S), so the given image-prime hypothesis supplies the contraction equality. Compose StructureSheaf.stalkIso with the inverse stalk isomorphism of c. Its algebra-map compatibility, stalkMap_comp and stalkMap_toStalk show that this composite sends every s in A to the actual structural germ at x. The private helper affine_chart_stalk_germs implements this argument completely.

mathlib_searches.query: Normalization of a finite disjoint union of field spectra over a discrete valuation ring has stalks equal to localizations of integral closures in field factors of a tensor product
The stalk of the relative normalization in a coproduct of spectra of fields is isomorphic to the localization of the integral closure in one generic tensor field factor
mathlib_searches.verdict: Binary normalization coproduct isomorphisms only; the full tensor-factor stalk identification is not stated.
Related normalization and unramified APIs only; no tame root theorem.

from.place: Trait tame calculation: identify normalized component local rings and their structural root germs with actual scheme stalks.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_galois_components_stalk_factor
    (B : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (pi : B) (hpi : Irreducible pi) (n : ℕ) (hnpos : 0 < n)
    (r : ℕ) (E : Fin r → Type u) [∀ i, Field (E i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra (FractionRing B) (E i)]
    (hE : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) (E i) ∧
      IsGalois (FractionRing B) (E i))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B)))
    (e : X ≅ ∐ fun i : Fin r ↦ Spec (CommRingCat.of (E i)))
    (he : e.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i : Fin r ↦
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (FractionRing B) (E i)))) = p) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B A))
    let j := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B)))
    let a := pullback.snd (p ≫ j) q
    ∀ (hqc : QuasiCompact a) (hqs : QuasiSeparated a),
    letI := hqc
    letI := hqs
    ∀ (x : a.normalization),
      (a.fromNormalization x).asIdeal = Ideal.span
        {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)} →
    letI : ∀ i, Algebra B (E i) := fun i ↦
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing B) (E i)).comp
        (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))).toAlgebra
    ∃ (i : Fin r) (P : Ideal (E i ⊗[B] A)) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
    letI := hP
    let F := (E i ⊗[B] A) ⧸ P
    let alpha : A →+* F := (Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] E i ⊗[B] A).toRingHom
    letI := alpha.toAlgebra
    let S := integralClosure A F
    ∃ (Q : Ideal S) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
    letI := hQ
    Q.comap (algebraMap A S) = Ideal.span
      {AdjoinRoot.root ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ n - Polynomial.C pi)} ∧
    ∃ (epsilon : Localization.AtPrime Q ≃+* a.normalization.presheaf.stalk x),
      ∀ s : A, epsilon (algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime Q) (algebraMap A S s)) =
        (a.fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom
          (StructureSheaf.toStalk A (a.fromNormalization x) s)
